title: Kidou Senkan Nadesico: Yappari Saigo wa "Ai ga Katsu"?
native_title: 機動戦艦ナデシコ ～やっぱり最後は「愛が勝つ」？～
overview: Kidou Senkan Nadesico: Yappari Saigo wa "Ai ga Katsu"? is a love adventure game based on the Martian Successor Nadesico anime series. It consists of eight chapters, which each contain an adventure segment and a battle segment. The adventure segments play in standard Japanese adventure style, with the player able to move to different parts of the ship and speak with the various characters via menu commands; a major element is building Akito's relationship with each of 10 different love interests, and if their affection is high enough it's possible to invite them to a date at the ship's virtual room. The battle segments consist of simple ship-to-ship combat, with the player repeating button sequences shown on the screen to launch attacks. The other characters help during these sequences, and their affection level with Akito will also affect their effectiveness in battle.
